notes.title: Demo updated to v1.3
notes.notes: [p]We just released a small update for the BioMenace Remastered demo:[/p][list][*][p]"Classic" presentation now runs at the original framerate (35 FPS) so you get authentic choppy scrolling and sprite movement as in the original. You can still play with classic graphics and smooth scrolling/framerate, if you prefer - or even modern graphics and choppy. This is controlled by the "Smooth Motion" setting in the options.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Restart Level" option in the menu and a corresponding keybinding (F11 by default)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated hostage and block pushing sprites[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing Snake to continue walking without any input after a dialog ends when using the analog stick to move[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect starting health in secret level[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed parallax background pixel shimmering artifacts and dark outlines on certain foreground tiles when "Smooth parallax" enabled[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "Cycle HUD style" key binding not checking if the key is already in use elsewhere[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.notes: [p]We've just released a free demo for BioMenace Remastered, featuring the first four levels of the game's first episode. We hope to already give you a feel for what our version will be like, while we continue working on episode 4 and polishing and fine-tuning various other aspects of the full game.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo also features online leaderboards and a speedrunner mode! And your save file will be carried over into the full game once it releases.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="FBCgXv6r65s;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p] We'd love to hear what you think - let us know in the Steam forums, or on our [url="https://discord.gg/uJB6kqPgpq"]Discord server[/url].[/p]

notes.title: The Original BioMenace (DOS) with a sneak-peek of BioMenace Remastered!
notes.notes: Dosgamert is a Youtuber with a main love for MS-DOS games. It's an interesting match since he's also the Lead Q&A and head of marketing for the upcoming BioMenace Remastered. Tonight we're having a closer look at the original game - and even a sneak-peek of a few levels of BioMenace Remastered. If you have any questions about BioMenace Remastered, the devs are present in the chat!

notes.title: BioMenace livestream tomorrow including sneak peek at the Remaster
notes.notes:
